result.rationale: The diff shows an explicit opt-in mechanism: config/site_settings.yml defaults `embeddable_host: ''`, and embed_controller.rb raises `Discourse::InvalidAccess.new('embeddable host not set') if SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank?` plus requires `URI(request.referer).host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`. So the feature is off by default and only enabled when an admin explicitly sets the host — the finding's claim of 'no explicit opt-in flag' is contradicted by these lines; the rest is design preference.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `EmbedController` gates embedding solely via `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` (blank check + referer host match) in `ensure_embeddable`, with no separate `embedding_enabled`/feature-flag style setting. When `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` returns nil, it enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`, which eventually calls `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` → `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, @embed_url)` and performs `open(url).read`. So setting `embeddable_host` effectively enables the embed/retrieval behavior. However, this appears to be an intentional design choice (using `embeddable_host` as the opt-in gate), not a clearly verifiable defect from the diff alone; it's a configuration/architecture concern about explicit opt-in/toggle granularity.
